title: Assess criterion verification
statement: As a product manager, I can see whether each accepted criterion has current, policy-compliant test proof so I know which product obligations are evidenced and which remain uncertain.

acceptance_criteria.statement: For each accepted criterion, quality reports covered only when every policy-required coverage kind is supplied by an active linked test whose automation is allowed and whose test definition, passed run, and any referenced evidence are current.

Quality reports every required kind separately and preserves its observable state—missing, not run, failed, blocked, skipped, stale, inactive, invalid, conflicted, excluded, or automation not allowed—instead of collapsing uncertainty into a pass.
